name: Kittiara Valentine
source: Mayor of Ramalien and owner of a very popular gym. She is the mother of Haru, Fuyu and Aki. She has mental powers that allow her to sense the feelings of people close to her. This makes her a very gentle and kind person. Her appearance is quite youthful, despite her age. People close to her call her "Kitty".
